title: 大阪杯の後に・やるしかなくない？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finishing the race completely out of breath, Tosen Jordan gets another taste of how intense senior G1 competition can be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Annoyingly, Gold Ship doesn't seem the least bit tired—in fact, she's yelling and screaming to get the crowd riled up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fired up from her rivalry with Gold Ship, Tosen Jordan no longer has any doubts in her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps realizing this, Gold Ship challenges her to continue their rivalry in the spring Tenno Sho.
